cohort: The study included 870 preterm infants born in the Affiliated Yangming Hospital of Ningbo University from June 2021 to December 2024.
finding: The incidence of Ureaplasma urealyticum infection in preterm infants was about 10%, with delivery method, gestational age, and C-reactive protein level identified as independent influencing factors.
mod_finding: Natural birth/forceps delivery was identified as a significant risk factor for Ureaplasma urealyticum infection in premature newborns.
